{{Quote|Did we see you guys come in on that freighter? Looks like a good ship you got there – little banged up and grotty, but a good ship. We fly a Nova Courier ourselves, the ''Lucky Guess''.|[[Orpa Vio|Orpa]] and [[Wex Vio]]|<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
The '''''Lucky Guess''''' was a modified [[YKL-37R Nova Courier]] cargo ship in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was owned by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] smuggler siblings [[Orpa Vio|Orpa]] and [[Wex Vio]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
